messages:
Maya: quick design check on Request Drilldown 3 export visibility + copy nits. users keep missing export behind kebab.
Ethan: agree, kebab hides it. suggestion: keep export in overflow visually but make it first in DOM so Tab reaches it quickly.
Ravi: ops note: when traces are big, accidental exports hit S3 costs. suggest adding estimated file size and a clear confirmation.
Maya: copy proposal: change button label to 'Export trace (.json)' to clarify format. also change modal title to 'Export trace — include logs & spans' so options are explicit.
Ethan: accessibility: current copy action only shows transient toast. need aria-live announcement and focus management for modal close (restore focus to trigger).
A11yBot: recommended pattern: invisible element with role=status and aria-live=polite updated on copy. ensure toast contrast >= 4.5:1 and that focus isn't moved unexpectedly.
Ravi: I'll add a server-side warning when estimated size > 5MB and an async option.
Maya: plan: Ethan will do the DOM reorder + aria-live + focus-restore in one PR. Ravi handles large-export follow-up. I'll update Figma and add QA checklist.
Ethan: starting branch after standup, will include keyboard-order tests.
Maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
